methodology: Compared Quran 11:41-45 Arabic/English (Quran.com) with Genesis 7-8 Hebrew/JPS (Sefaria). This is a received-text comparison, not critical manuscript collation. Do not infer dependence; do not publish candidate links.

ayat.assessment: Noah invites boarding in God's name and invokes divine mercy. Genesis 7:1,7,13-16 records divine instruction and boarding, but no matching invocation by Noah.
Ark moves through high waves and Noah calls to a son who stands apart. Genesis 7:17-18 describes ark afloat, but Genesis 7:13 names Noah's sons as boarding; no corresponding dialogue.
Son proposes mountain refuge, refuses boarding and drowns. No matching individual son scene in inspected Genesis 7-8; contrast with Genesis 7:13 where Noah's three sons board.

Earth/sky commanded to cease flood; ark rests on al-Judi. Genesis 8:2-4 narrates closing deep fountains/heavenly floodgates, waters receding and ark resting on mountains of Ararat. Distinct place names; later Targum Onkelos Genesis 8:4 has Kardu, whose textual transmission/date require separate study.
Noah petitions concerning his drowned son and the family promise. Genesis 7-8 does not depict this petition; all Noah's sons board in Genesis 7:13.

staged_candidates.relationship: shared ark boarding episode, different speaker and prayer
shared floating ark setting; contrasting sons
shared flood recession and ark rest; divergent geographical designations
